title: Case 015: Cancel future Direct Debit collections
initial_request: I want H&V to cancel my active Direct Debit mandate to Northmere Fitness so it cannot be used for future collections.
overview: Mara Ellison saw an active Northmere Fitness Direct Debit mandate in her secure portal and asked H&V to cancel it. After completing identification checks by phone, she gave the bank her instruction. The agent checked the collection-stage information, submitted that instruction, and the secure portal then showed the mandate as cancelled.

next_action.summary: After the identification checks, review whether any collection may already be processing, then submit Mara’s cancellation instruction through H&V’s protected process.

outcome: The secure portal shows the Northmere Fitness Direct Debit mandate as cancelled. Any collection already in processing and Mara’s agreement with Northmere Fitness remain separate matters; no refund or end to any debt is confirmed.

events.body: Direct Debit mandate: Northmere Fitness — Active.

I’ve completed your identification checks. Please cancel my Northmere Fitness Direct Debit mandate; I understand this is an instruction to my bank, not a cancellation of my agreement with the recipient.
I completed the required identification checks and reviewed the collection-stage information. I cannot rule out a collection already being processed, so that needs separate reconciliation.
I have submitted Mara Ellison’s checked instruction to cancel the Northmere Fitness mandate. This submission records her instruction; I am not authorising it on her behalf.
Direct Debit mandate: Northmere Fitness — Cancelled.
